title: Villager Trade Unlock
description: This datapack adds the ability to reset a locked villager's trades.
body:
## Simple Villager Trade Reset

This datapack allows players to use a similar mechanic to zombie villager curing to reset a villager's trades after they have already been traded with. To do this, simply apply the slowness effect, hold shift, and right click the villager with a brick item. The villager's job, workstation, and trades will be reset, while retaining custom names and inventory contents.

The pack also adds a new advancement for the first time a player resets a villager's trades.
